task_definition.task_description: Please check what connected devices are in the living room, then look up the status of the living room AC and set it to cool at 24°C. After that, turn on the living room light to 70% brightness, and then back up the workspace and send me an in-app notification when it’s done.

user_input.query: Please check what connected devices are in the living_room first. Then look up the status of my AC with thermostat_device_id ac_living in the living_room and set it to hvac_mode cool. I know the target_temperature is 22, but please set it to 24°C. After that, turn on the light with light_device_id light_living in the living_room, set light_state to on, and adjust the light_brightness to 70%. The device_type field is blank (""). Once that’s done, back up the workspace at /projects/ops-room using the backup_name post_environment_adjustment_backup, and send an in-app notification on the alert_channel app with alert_priority medium to user_id user_123 when the backup finishes.

Please check what connected devices are in the living_room first. Then look up the status of my AC with thermostat_device_id ac_living in the living_room and set it to hvac_mode cool. After that, turn on the light with light_device_id light_living in the living_room, set light_state to on, and adjust the light_brightness to 70%. The device_type field is blank (""). Once that’s done, back up the workspace at /projects/ops-room using the backup_name post_environment_adjustment_backup, and send an in-app notification on the alert_channel app with alert_priority medium to user_id user_123 when the backup finishes.
